Fixed positive launch speed, constant positive gravity, no drag, equal launch and landing height.
Angle in [0,float64(pi/2)] radians; zero angle is limiting flight-root extension.
Angles retain actual float64 values: float64(pi/2) has a small positive range, not exact vertical zero.
Maximum range uses exact mathematical pi/4 independently of the rounded returned optimizing angle.
Local450digit arithmetic; nonzero output underflow and overflow reject; no universal correct-rounding claim.
Boundary conditions, reversed source feed and mathematical pi explicitly reconstructed; no literal AST parity.
No unequal-height, drag, curved-earth or variable-gravity optimization.
Positive fixed launch speed and constant downward gravity; equal launch and landing heights, no drag, matching arrays.
Landing boundary conditions are supplied; nonzero flight-root cancellation and corrected trigonometric feed order are explicit. No literal source parity.
Reuse the unchanged approved provider for flight time, horizontal displacement, rounded maximizing angle and independently rounded exact optimum range.
First-quadrant literal float64 radians are not snapped to symbolic endpoints; zero angle is a limiting extension. No unequal-height or varying-speed optimization claim.

publication.technical: Compute level-ground projectile flight time, horizontal range, maximizing angle and maximum range for fixed positive launch speed and constant downward gravity without drag. Equal launch and landing height is required. Literal float64 radians are used without endpoint snapping; zero angle is a limiting flight-root extension. The returned angle is rounded pi/4, while maximum range independently evaluates the exact fixed-speed optimum.
publication.plain: Supply launch speed, gravity and launch angle in radians in matching arrays. Receive flight time, horizontal displacement, the rounded best angle and maximum range. Launch and landing heights must match. Zero angle returns the limiting zero-time result; a floating-point near-vertical angle retains its small horizontal range. Different landing heights, drag and speed that varies with angle require another model.

bound.validity_statement: Positive fixed launch speed and constant gravity, no drag, equal launch and landing heights. First-quadrant angles interpreted as actual float64 radians; zero-angle limiting flight-root extension. No unequal-height optimization.

reference.title: OpenStax University Physics Volume1: Projectile Motion
reference.relevance_note: Ideal no-drag level-ground projectile flight and fixed-speed maximum range.
